_note: 1.81.0 (owner-approved planning/DRAFT_event_frame.md, release A1): the shared event frame's data. chances: optional things {{user}} may do at an event (data/calendar.json event id -> list), never required and never reminded. Each is done once a campaign year (max: how many times). how: at (place keys, lowercase without 'the'), day (the event day it belongs to, else any of its days), from / to ('HH:MM'; 'to' may pass 24:00 into the next event day), min (minutes the reply covers there), said (a regex the reply's text must match), club ({{user}} is in a club), trip (the Trip is active or the Location matches this regex), practice (a /Practice action accepted this reply), other_dorm (its partner is from another dorm), deed (a /Rep_events kind reported this reply). reward: prof [Field, XP] ('club' = the club's Field; uncapped, as the 1.26.0 event XP was), moment (a line in the Recent moments of every Rank 3+ bond present), or nothing (the chance only marks it done). legacy: the key the 1.26.0 event XP used ($eng.prof.days 'event:<year>:<key>'), read as done so a save never pays twice. Engine: stepProficiency (eventChances); UI: the Activities Event tab.

contest._note: 1.82.0 (planning/DRAFT_event_frame.md section 3, release A2): the Dorm Competition, computed from the seed and never stored (shared.js contest section; tools/common.py presence_data hands it to the engine and the panels as PD.ct). roles: a Halvard student's combat role in the brackets (owner-approved draft table 3.4; Castor by his public magic). pins: only what the lore says (str: strength added; lose: the round they go out in, 'semi' = the semi-final; tie: 'first' wins the tie for the better of the places shared by that round's losers; years: campaign years the pin holds). dorm: bracket size per role per dorm, qualifying places (lore 19), each role's format and the rounds' times. strength: an entrant's (base + per_year x (school year - 1) + 0..spread), {{user}}'s (user_base + user_per_year x (Year - 1) + user_per_prowess x Prowess rank); a bout between two entrants the narrator does not play goes to A with 50 + (A - B) percent, clamped; edge: the gap that makes an opponent stronger or weaker (Fortune -10 / +10). vote: the Club Festival coin vote, drawn at the close weighted by (named members + base), with {{user}}'s club boosted for each of its chances done. 1.87.0 (release C): pins noteam = no team takes them at the Academy Competition (Royhan, lore 101, unless {{user}} recruits him; Ruby, lore 130). academy: the Academy Competition (lore 19): the Dorm qualifiers form teams of size with every school year among them and the roles covered as far as they go; a knockout of teams, one round a day at times, the strength of a team its members' mean.

breaks._note: 1.83.0 (planning/DRAFT_event_frame.md 4.3, release B): who of the Halvard students stays on campus over a break (a calendar event with home: the Mid-Year Break, the Month 12 holiday; lore 238: staying is 'allowed and common'). stay: those whose lore leaves them no home to go to or keeps them here (Etnie, a street orphan; Dante, raised in an orphanage and the Doves' errand-runner; Lenna, whose village and parents the Blightfire took; Castor, whose home is Halvard's Mail Tower; Tilly, whose 'far northern province' is a cover for Velmora). Everyone else stays with chance percent, drawn per student, campaign year and break. The others are away (whereabouts 'home for the break').

fools._note: 1.83.0 (planning/DRAFT_event_frame.md 4.2): Secret Fools Day's dorm name-draw for {{user}} (lore 235): the name {{user}} draws and who drew {{user}}, each a roster dorm-mate at Halvard this year with named percent, else a dorm-mate the narrator invents. Computed, never stored.

kingdom._note: 1.84.0 (owner-approved planning/DRAFT_kingdom_competition.md): the Kingdom Competition in three rounds, run by the engine (stepKingdom) from the seed and what the story reported. teams: the four academies in order (Halvard first); tactic: how each team plays (from its members' lore: Veyra hunts, Bellatrix; Myrdath slips past, Ines and Lucius; Ashvale holds what it takes, Elion's new team), tact: what a tactic changes (ambush: the chance to attack a holder, times; guard: guards left in held rooms, plus or minus; retreat: % a team backs out of a meeting instead of fighting; retake: a held room of another team is a target); pins: strength added to a rival (each academy's Rank 1); rival: strength added to every rival team member (each team is its academy's best, as Halvard's is). r1: the Kingsmeadow hunt (Wed): three Kingsblooms planted on spots by the seed, one hour a tick from `from`: find (% a team without one finds one in the field), sign (% a Halvard team searching gets a sign of one), ambush (% a team attacks a holder), warn (minutes before sunset <now> warns); the judges take one bloom a team at `to` (sunset). r2: the Undercroft (Thu): ten rooms with a bound beast's grade, beasts per grade (the Expedition's names), boss (a beast's strength by grade), every `tick` minutes; a room is taken by downing its beast and being the only team in it for `hold` minutes (the count stops while another team is inside); the two teams holding `win` rooms at the same time go through; group: strength a member adds to a group; boss_seal: % a seal breaks in a failed fight with a beast. r3: the final on the sand (Sat), off-screen decided at `rolled`. credit: what each deed adds to a competitor's record (the World panel picks `world` competitors, one per combat role, by record and strength).

hunt._note: 1.86.0 (planning/DRAFT_event_frame.md 4.7, release E): Founder Day's treasure hunt (lore 25). stops clues, drawn each campaign year from the campus places with lore (data/locations.json lore) except exclude (location ids: private, out of bounds or the dorms), all different; from / to: the hunt's hours on the day (after the rite until the evening). A clue counts as solved when {{user}} is at its place within the hours and the reply speaks of the clue, riddle or hunt (said). Computed, never stored; $eng.hunt keeps how far {{user}} got.

tally._note: 1.87.0 (planning/DRAFT_event_frame.md 3.1, release C): the tally format, scores by dorm at an event's close (lore: Sports Day's medals, the Academy Showcase's scores). n events (or acts), each giving gold, silver and copper (3, 2, 1 points) to three different dorms, drawn from the seed weighted by base + the dorm's roster students at Halvard that year in clubs (Sports Day: the sport clubs, magic banned; the Showcase: the stage clubs) + boost for each of {{user}}'s chances done there (for {{user}}'s dorm). by: medals (gold first) or points. Computed; $eng.tally keeps only that the Journal has it.
